Area 30 feet, all enemies who can perceive you

Effect each takes a −2 status penalty to its next attack roll or Perception check made to coordinate with allies

Shout down an enemy line until it stops working as one.

cinderfall.notSpell: deadhand's class document carries system.spellcasting 0, so this is an ability, not a spell, and convert_class_spells.py declines it by design as a NON_CASTERS owner
